name: railvanta
description: Sandbox multi-rail payment orchestration platform (Go API + Next.js dashboard)

scripts.build: pnpm run build:api && pnpm run build:web
scripts.lint: pnpm run lint:api && pnpm run lint:web && pnpm run lint:openapi
scripts.format: pnpm run format:api && pnpm -r --if-present run format
scripts.test: pnpm run test:api && pnpm run test:web
scripts.test:e2e:quickstart: RUN_QUICKSTART=1 pnpm --filter @railvanta/e2e --fail-if-no-match exec playwright test -c playwright.quickstart.config.ts
scripts.check: node scripts/check-workspaces.mjs && pnpm run compose:config && pnpm run check:tracked && pnpm run lint && pnpm run check:generated && pnpm run check:docs && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run build
scripts.format:check: make -C backend format-check && pnpm -r --if-present run format:check
